s05157.summary: On siege day eleven, Nadia hides in a stall as Mom's texts fail.
Kofi drags injured Lucas in and wedges the door with a mop.
Nadia reveals herself from the stall and Kofi lowers his light.
Lucas's ankle is badly swollen as a blast shakes the walls.
A voice claiming to be Ms. Brandt asks to be let in.
They whisper-argue; Kofi says Brandt left on the first bus.
The handle turns against the mop as shadows glide past outside.
Mom texts I love you and Nadia clutches the phone wordlessly.
Nadia coldly catches Kofi's hand on the mop and he pulls back.
Brandt's final warning, a bang, and all three dive beneath the sinks.
Smoke curls under the door; Mom texts that she's coming.

s05158.summary: At a misty checkpoint, the passport photo doesn't match the man.
Okonkwo presses Grieve, insisting the paperwork is immaculate.
Grieve says the perfection bothers him and trades dry barbs.
Vane says the order was revoked and both identities are false.
Okonkwo reaches for her briefcase and urges everyone to breathe.
The girl wakes and calls Okonkwo Mummy.
Grieve weighs the barrier and drops his clipboard.

s05159_0.summary: Nervous Beth and Cal wait in a quiet clinic waiting room.
Cal promises it'll be great; Beth recalls the camping trip.
Beth stares at a circling orange fish.
They're called in; flustered Beth drops her tissue and Cal steadies her.

s05159_1.summary: Dr. Okafor greets the couple, who insist they're fine.
They admit terror and say together it's been three years.
Okafor acknowledges their long hope and offers tissues as Beth cries.
Tina interrupts; the lab results arrive and Okafor's face changes.
Beth fears bad news; Okafor smiles and confirms it's a yes.
Beth weeps, Cal fumbles the model, and they hold each other.

s05160.summary: Juniper wearily announces take nineteen to a shaky camera.
Osei says Juniper rushed the bridge; they blame the click track.
Marguerite calls saying the label wants the single by Friday.
Juniper explodes that Marguerite made the promise, not them.
Juniper hurls the headphones into the glass; everyone scatters.

s05161.summary: Self-important supervisor Barry strides into the warehouse at dawn.
Nadine and Robin deadpan through Barry's early-bird pep talk.
Barry starts the belt and insists today is totally normal.
Robin and Nadine agree Barry is obviously lying.
An unscanned private box rolls by and Nadine asks about it.
Barry blusters that some boxes just lack barcodes.
The box rattles and sweating Barry begs them to put it down.
Nadine rips it open: shampoo, stolen name tags, a boss award.
Barry admits he made himself an award to be presented Friday.
Nadine announces it to the warehouse and Barry buries his face.
Nadine tosses him shampoo and Robin crowns him with the sign.

s05162.summary: Wired Detective Brandt waits at the rooftop bar watching the elevator.
Hale calls, says he's in the garage, and asks if she's alone.
Brandt tests Hale's repeated location and lets it pass.
An anonymous text warns she is not alone up there.
Brandt radios backup about the garage and gets only a click.
Hale steps out of the elevator and sits warily beside her.
Hale reveals he never called; a man has his phone and kid's schedule.
The watcher texts orders; Brandt realizes he's heard everything.
Brandt stands and orders Hale to stay seated whatever happens.
She lays the wire on the bar and turns to face him.

s05164.summary: Mira rides a rainy night bus across from a hooded man.
Mira calls Dad, admitting she left for Aunt Lena's without telling.
Teodor says he's not mad; Mira bitterly calls out his voice.
The hooded man tenses and turns his lit phone face down.
Mira erupts that he always says nothing, even when Mom left.
The hooded man lowers his hood: Teodor, apologizing aloud across the aisle.
Teodor stands and asks her to say it all to his face.

s05166.summary: Teens in a laundromat warn each other as Colt eyes Mo's duffel.
Colt demands his stuff; Mo says it belongs to Wren.
Wren appears, Jaylen blocks Colt, and flash drives spill everywhere.
Priscilla declares she saw nothing; Tessa mutters I told you.
Colt grabs a drive and Wren lunges at him.
Lights flicker and police lights sweep the window; everyone freezes.

s05167.summary: Dr. Pruitt makes Lucas explain how Mrs. Abernathy's cat vanished.
Lucas finds torn kibble and paw prints leading to the staff door.
The knob turns by itself; Pruitt shields Abernathy, Lucas raises the flashlight.
The door opens on darkness and two green eyes.
Deputy Harlow bangs in out of the storm and surveys the scene.
Harlow reports a break-in call; Pruitt and Lucas deny it too fast.
Harlow says the call came from inside the clinic.
Biscuit steps into the light with a tiny brass key on her collar.

s05168.summary: A packed subway stalls; Francesca is pinned against the door.
Devin apologizes for his cake box and says it's his sister's wedding.
They realize they're in the same wedding; she needles his RSVPs.
Gus chuckles that they should marry; both say no together.
Lights die and frantic texts show the ceremony is in twenty minutes.
In the blue glow, they look at each other and soften.
The train lurches; Francesca saves the cake in a chain of catches.

s05169.summary: A desert barn studio idles while Abel stares at the monitor.
Abel accuses Clementine of slowing yesterday's bridge.
Hux admits he slowed it because it felt like riding in.
The band asks if they're ready; Abel says not yet.
Clementine and Hux push Abel to say yes for once.
Abel grabs his hat and shoulders past Hux for the door.
Abel sees the ON AIR light; Clementine has been recording.
The band asks again and Abel finally says yeah.

s05170.summary: Night nurse Priya checks on a boy waiting with a silent woman.
The woman refuses help while Priya gently probes.
Gus checks in and Priya waves him off.
The woman explains her mother is upstairs and kids aren't allowed.
Priya offers to sit with Toby; the exhausted woman looks up.
Denise lets go of the strap; Toby teases Priya's badge photo.
Dr. Okafor says Denise's mother wants them both upstairs tonight.
Denise thanks Priya and leaves with Toby as Gus holds the elevator.

s05172.summary: Juno lies awake in her dark bedroom, listening.
Slow thuds through the wall; her phone is dead; a wrong hum.
Juno whispers hello and creeps out of bed, freezing at a creak.
A flat Wonderwall reveals a garage band rehearsing next door.
Relieved, Juno laughs and yells that it's one a.m.
She settles back, unaware her closet door has opened an inch.
The voices whisper they're not in the garage; her eyes snap open.

s05173.summary: Dr. Voss works on a collapsed man as a bleeding stranger blocks a dryer.
Marcus gives his name and Lena asks who did this.
Josie backs away calling 911 as a terrier yaps.
Security guard Abel bursts in ordering nobody to move.
Marcus urges Abel to chase the attacker; Abel doesn't go.
Officer Kane storms in, gun raised, demanding hands.
Everyone raises their hands except Lena, still pressing the wound.
The dryer thuds; something inside is still running.

s05175.summary: During a blackout Sal cooks by candlelight with family around.
Big Dave arrives soaked with ice; Sal and Kay banter.
Teddy's mug tower collapses and Kay teases him.
Dave points out a still woman with an umbrella on the drive.
Sal lets in Ruth, who has the wrong house number.
The family welcomes Ruth with soup, bread and a chair.

s05176_0.summary: A trawler creaks through fog on black water.

s05176_1.summary: Nell presses a rag to Jonah's bleeding wound and calls Dr. Sun.
Nell reports the deep wound and names Pete as the only option.
Pale Pete refuses to do it again.
Dr. Sun insists Pete can do it.
Something heavy drags across the deck and the hatch shakes.
Jonah warns something's out there and the lights die.

s05179_0.summary: Rosa flips tortillas for a long line while teasing Danny.
Skye warns the health inspector is coming; Rosa shrugs it off.

s05179_1.summary: Chuy warns the whistling propane tank is low.
Rosa hears the hiss and orders Skye to check; Skye refuses.
Danny volunteers but Rosa orders him to stay at the window.

s05179_2.summary: Inspector Wells pulls up and calls for whoever's in charge.
Rosa dodges the permit question; Skye corrects her; Wells heads in.

s05179_3.summary: Wells smells gas and Rosa jokes it off as tortillas.
Skye spots the cracked hose, now audibly hissing.
Danny admits the leak since Friday; Rosa turns on him and Chuy.
Wells orders everyone out; Rosa refuses, defending thirty years.
The gauge hits red; Rosa rebuffs Skye and blames them all.
Danny apologizes and Rosa's anger drains away.
Rosa lunges for the valve as Wells grabs her and Skye shouts out.
The hiss stops, a still beat, then the grill erupts in fire.

s05179_4.summary: Everyone drags each other clear as smoke billows from the truck.
Rosa deadpans about the inspection and everyone, even Wells, laughs.

s05182.summary: A band sets up for take fourteen as a storm builds outside.
They count in and play until the take falls apart.
Talkback is dead; the click ticks on and nobody answers.
Rain leaks in and guitarists head to check the breaker.
The click stops and a rising transformer whine fills the walls.
They yank cables and tangle, crashing to the floor.
Water spreads toward the power strips in silence.
Everything powers up screaming; they flee as lights burst.
Outside in the rain, they count heads: all five safe.

s05183.summary: Kim backs along a flooded hotel corridor, narrating the disaster.
Kip limps in with an axe; Sora drags bleeding Mrs. Odom.
Kim's phone flickers with a message, then dies again.
The siblings find the stairs flooded; Sora says go for the roof.
A pipe bursts and the lights die into darkness.

s05184.summary: In an emptied wedding barn, the cake topper climbs down.
Corgi Gus trots in with a garter and Bea skids up to him.
Bea orders the garter dropped; Gus causes chaos and denies cheating.
Bea sets ground rules for the relay; Gus protests.
A cork pops and they race through the barn.
They tie at the ribbon and Gus crowns Bea with the garter.

s05186.summary: Joni hosts Grandma Lucille's funeral reception while Ames watches the siblings.
Jory grumbles; Ames mentions the will reading and Joni stiffens.
The siblings laugh about Lucille's terrible driving.
A text about the house freezes Ames; Jory catches Joni noticing.
Jory stops Ames leaving and demands what house.
Joni admits Grandma sold her the house for a dollar.

s05187_0.summary: A busy startup office; Tavi stares at a laptop.
Rhea asks for a word; Tavi stalls, then follows her.

s05187_1.summary: Rhea says the Series B failed and payroll is Friday.
Tavi reminds Rhea she promised cover through spring.
A board member is already on his way up.
Osei's text exposes Tavi; they admit signing it.
The dog trots to the elevator as it dings open.

s05188.summary: Three people sit in a church basement beneath a singing choir.
Pat tries to begin; Patsy needles him and they bicker.
Deacon mutters for a drink, then claims he was humming.
Pat declares what's said under the floor stays there.
Deacon exposes Patsy's relapses; Pat lets slip a third drink.
Deacon rises denouncing liars and everyone shouts over the organ.
A pickle jar smashes; Patsy calls it a sign; Deacon wants one.

s05189_0.summary: An old trawler wallows at dawn; Captain Voss stands in the wheelhouse.
First-season deckhand Lin hauls nets with torn gloves.

s05189_1.summary: The Coast Guard warns of a force nine gale within hours.
Voss sets down the handset and stares at the heaving sea.
A text begs Dad to come home; he turns it face down.

s05189_2.summary: Lin asks for news; unseen Noelle answers from the hold.
Lin sees a grey wall of storm climbing the horizon.
Voss orders Lin to cut the six-ton net.
Lin cuts the rope and the net falls away into the dark.

s05190.summary: Corporal Voss stamps papers at a rainy 1948 checkpoint.
Marta presents papers and holds her breath as Voss checks them.
Voss flags a stamp from a nonexistent town; Marta quips back.
The barrier slams; Voss shakes the violin and it rattles.
Marta begs him to choose mercy over breaking her mother's violin.
Voss needles her talking; she admits fear; he sets the violin down.
A muddy brass band arrives demanding passage; the boy bolts.
Voss lifts the barrier and tells them to go.
